metadata.title: लाह से लाखों कमाने का तरीका क्या है ? |  Lac is Changing Tribal Lives in Jharkhand
metadata.description:
In the forests of Jharkhand, lac cultivation is becoming a lifeline for thousands of Adivasi families. Harvested from trees like Kusum, Palash, and Ber, lac is more than just a forest produce — it is a source of steady income, self-reliance, and dignity.

For many tribal households, lac farming provides cash earnings without leaving their villages. Women are actively involved in cultivation and processing, strengthening both family incomes and community resilience. The Agriculture Ministry is now supporting farmers with training and modern techniques to promote scientific lac cultivation and improve productivity.

This is the story of how a traditional forest practice is transforming livelihoods and creating sustainable economic opportunities in tribal Jharkhand.
